title: M$^2$PFN: End-to-End Disentangled Alignment for Generalizable Multimodal In-Context Learning in Alzheimer's Disease
abstract: arXiv:2609.28836v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While various multimodal methods combining imaging and tabular data for Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis were proposed, they are often limited in generalization across cohorts. In-context learning (ICL) has demonstrated excellent generalization performances and high flexibility in foundational tabular models such as TabPFN. To extend TabPFN's ICL to multimodal AD analysis, the main obstacle is that TabPFN is meta-trained on synthetic tabular priors that do not naturally match the statistical structure of image-derived features. We propose M$^2$PFN, an end-to-end framework that turns this tabular foundation model into a multimodal AD predictor. translated_title: M²PFN：面向阿尔茨海默病可泛化多模态上下文学习的端到端解耦对齐
translated_abstract: 尽管已有多种结合影像与表格数据进行阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断的多模态方法被提出，但它们在跨队列泛化方面往往存在局限。上下文学习（ICL）已在TabPFN等基础表格模型中展现出卓越的泛化性能和高度灵活性。将TabPFN的ICL扩展至多模态AD分析的主要障碍在于：TabPFN是在合成表格先验上进行元训练的，而这些先验与图像衍生特征的统计结构并不天然匹配。我们提出了M²PFN，一个能将该表格基础模型转变为多模态AD预测器的端到端框架。M²PFN (i) 通过TabPFN的transformer执行可微推理，将任务梯度反向传播至3D-MRI编码器和表格编码器；(ii) 通过解耦与对比目标，将两种模态对齐到与ICL引擎先验相匹配的共享子空间中；(iii) …（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出端到端框架M²PFN，通过在TabPFN的transformer中进行可微推理、并利用解耦与对比学习将3D-MRI和表格模态对齐至共享子空间，从而把表格基础模型的上下文学习能力扩展为可跨队列泛化的多模态阿尔茨海默病诊断器。
en_tdlr: M²PFN is an end-to-end framework that turns the tabular foundation model TabPFN into a generalizable multimodal Alzheimer's disease predictor by performing differentiable inference through its transformer and aligning 3D-MRI and tabular modalities into a shared subspace via disentanglement and contrastive objectives.
